SELECT 
    time_of_sample_collection,
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'PH' THEN result END AS "pH (s.u.)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'Temperature' THEN result END AS "Temperature (Celsius)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'Alkalinity' THEN result END AS "Alkalinity (mg/l CaCO3)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'COD' THEN result END AS "COD (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'Volatile Acids' THEN result END AS "Volatile_Acids (mg/l Acetic Acid)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'VSS' THEN result END AS "VSS (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'TSS' THEN result END AS "TSS (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test = 'TKN' THEN result END AS "TKN (mg/l)"
FROM 
    user_labtestdata 
WHERE 
    form_id = 192
    AND location = '${LabTestLocation:raw}'
AND
  $__timeFilter(time_of_sample_collection);

SELECT
  datetime,

FROM

WHERE
  form_id = 193
AND
  $__timeFilter(datetime);

WITH sperate AS (
  SELECT
    date_fed_into_eq_tank,
    cow_manure_quantity,
    borewell_water,
    filtrate_water
  FROM
    user_feedstockdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 191
    AND eq_tank_fed = '${EQTankFed:raw}'
    AND '${EQTankFed:raw}' != 'Total'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_fed_into_eq_tank)
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    date_fed_into_eq_tank,
    COALESCE(SUM(cow_manure_quantity), 0) AS cow_manure_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(borewell_water), 0) AS borewell_water,
    COALESCE(SUM(filtrate_water), 0) AS filtrate_water
  FROM
    user_feedstockdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 191
    AND '${EQTankFed:raw}' = 'Total'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_fed_into_eq_tank)
  GROUP BY
    date_fed_into_eq_tank
)
-- select * from total;
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.date_fed_into_eq_tank, t.date_fed_into_eq_tank) AS "Date Fed into EQ Tank",
  COALESCE(s.cow_manure_quantity, t.cow_manure_quantity) AS "Cow manure quantity (tons)",
  COALESCE(s.borewell_water, t.borewell_water) AS "Borewell water (m3)",
  COALESCE(s.filtrate_water, t.filtrate_water) AS "Filtrate water (m3)"
FROM
  sperate s
FULL JOIN
  total t
ON
  s.date_fed_into_eq_tank = t.date_fed_into_eq_tank
ORDER BY "Date Fed into EQ Tank" ASC;

SELECT
  datetime,
  CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
          GREATEST(reset_value, 0)
      ELSE
          GREATEST(daily_power, 0)
  END AS "MCC1 Power Meter Reading (kwh)"
FROM
  user_powermeterreadingdata 
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(datetime) AND form_id = 193
ORDER BY datetime ASC;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', failure_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS "Day", -- Adjust to your required timezone
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (restore_time - failure_time)) / 3600) AS "Total Power Outage Duration (hours)",
  COUNT(failure_time) AS "Total Power Outage Count"
FROM
  user_poweroutagedata 
WHERE
  form_id = 198
  AND $__timeFilter(failure_time)
GROUP BY
  "Day"
